newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $785 mln on Thursday Nov 14.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $785 mln on Thursday Nov 14.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $785 million in 34 offerings for Thursday Nov 14, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $373 million in 26 offerings. The largest competitive issue is a $184 million Virginia Transportation Board issue at 1100 EST.
Negotiated sales total $411 million in 8 offerings. The largest issue is a $180 million Chicago Toll Bridge offering through PaineWebber Inc.
There are six issues totaling $189 million on the day-to-day calendar, which means dealers have indicated that the offerings may be brought to market. --U.S. Municipal Information Group, 212-859-1826
